title: apiRegistry
responsibility: Reads contracts for catalog entities, saved plans and backend units from the selected revision of the authorized project registry.

inputs.name: apiRegistry.client
inputs.description: The API service used to read the selected revision's registry and, for a contracts lookup with an id, a saved entity. Its read calls may reject; saved-entity HTTP 404 and the exact entity-not-found HTTP 400 are treated as a miss.

inputs.name: apiRegistry.snapshot
inputs.description: Carries the project, selected revision, writable status, and entity list; this function reads only revision.branch and revision.commit from it. Those revision values scope registry and entity reads.

inputs.name: apiRegistry.resource
inputs.description: Chooses the returned shape: registry yields registry data and units yields its unit list. With other values, id selects a unit contract or, when absent, the function returns id-and-contract summaries; contracts with an id first attempts a saved entity contract.

inputs.name: apiRegistry.id
inputs.description: Optional id for saved-entity or backend-unit lookup. For contracts, it is sent as entityId; after a saved-plan miss (or for other resource values), it is matched exactly against backend unit ids, and a missing unit throws ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: apiRegistry
outputs.description: Resolves to registry data, a units array, an id-and-contract summary array, or a contract value depending on resource and id. A contracts lookup tries the saved entity contract first; if that misses, an unmatched backend unit id rejects with ExpectedCliError.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when a supplied id matches neither a saved entity contract for a contracts lookup nor a backend unit at the selected revision. Saved-entity HTTP 404 responses and the exact entity-not-found HTTP 400 response count as a miss before the backend unit lookup.
